items.title: Residency for Artists Based in India - Winter 2027
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: covered
Stay: covered
Living: covered
You pay in total: not stated
items.eligibility: Indian nationals domiciled in India, under 40 years of age, contemporary visual artists, BFA/MFA or equivalent practice, IELTS not required, NET not required, language: English (proficient for interview), age: under 40. Cannot have received CWIT grant in last 5 years or previous Inlaks overseas opportunity.
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official Delfina Foundation guidance notes PDF and Charles Wallace India Trust page. Fully funded including return flight, visa reimbursement, living allowance £40/day, materials £1200, accommodation, travel pass.

items.title: Art Explora x Cité internationale des arts Residency Programme 2027

items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: covered
Stay: covered
Living: covered
You pay in total: not stated
items.eligibility: Artists of all nationalities and ages working in visual arts (painting, sculpture, etc.), performing or digital arts; minimum 5 years professional experience with international exhibition track record. items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official Art Explora programme page and Cité internationale des arts open call page. Fully funded: furnished studio-apartment ~50m², €1,000/month living stipend, production grant up to €3,000, round-trip travel to Paris. Applications open until 30 October 2026.

items.title: ONE WORLD Residency by KIAR
items.funding:
Fund: self-funded
Application fee: free
Programme fee: 850 USD for 15 days (single occupancy; higher for longer stays)
Travel: you pay
Stay: covered
Living: you pay
You pay in total: programme fee + travel + meals (meals can be arranged ~15 USD/day)
items.eligibility: Emerging to established visual artists (painting, sculpture, mixed media, etc.), any nationality, self-taught or graduates welcome. Degree not required. IELTS not required, NET not required. Language: English, Hindi. Age: 18+.
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official KIAR One World Residency page. Self-funded with listed programme fees including accommodation and studio; artist pays air travel, visa, and meals. Invitation letter available. Apply at least 40 days before preferred start; open for Sept-March sessions.

items.title: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) 2027/28
items.org: Research Grants Council, Hong Kong / participating universities
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: not stated
Programme fee: none
Travel: covered
Stay: covered
Living: covered
You pay in total: not stated
items.eligibility: Applicants seeking admission as new full-time PhD students at one of eight Hong Kong universities, any nationality. Must demonstrate outstanding academic performance, research ability/potential, communication and interpersonal skills, and leadership abilities. Typically requires Master's degree or equivalent (confirm with chosen university/programme). Degree: Master's or equivalent. Who can apply: outstanding international candidates. IELTS not stated, NET not required. Language: English. Age: not stated.
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official RGC HKPFS pages. Open for applications 1 September 2026 to 1 December 2026 (initial application by 12:00 noon Hong Kong Time). 400 fellowships for 2027/28. Annual stipend HK$344,400 (approx. US$44,150) + conference and research-related travel allowance HK$14,400 (approx. US$1,840) per year for up to 3 years; additional support possible from universities. Apply via initial application to RGC then full application to chosen university quoting reference number. Relevant for visual arts / visual culture / contemporary art practice research at participating universities.

items.title: Hashtag Kalakar Fully Funded Artists Residency 2026
items.location: Multiple cities (artist choice: NYC, Paris, Berlin, etc.)
items.funding:
Fund: application fee only
Application fee: USD 50
Programme fee: none (for selected)
Travel: covered (round-trip economy if selected)
Stay: covered (accommodation for 30 days if selected)
Living: you pay (food and personal expenses not included)
You pay in total: USD 50 + food/personal during residency (amount not stated)
items.eligibility: Visual artists 18+, any nationality, any medium (painting, sculpture, digital, etc.). Degree not required. IELTS not required, NET not required. Language: English. Age: 18+. Selection merit-based among global applicants; top 25 selected for residency.
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official Hashtag Kalakar page. Application registration deadline 16 Oct 2026 EST, submission 31 Oct. $50 participation fee for jury; if selected among top 25, round-trip flights, accommodation, and program covered. Food/personal expenses excluded. Invitation letter for visa. Note: mixed online reviews regarding platform trustworthiness; confirm details independently.
